nodes.label: WorkflowState
nodes.rationale: A TypedDict with total=False that is the de facto internal API between workflow nodes; errors is declared but never populated and references is unused by nodes.

nodes.label: Domain Contracts (RawInput, NormalizedInput, ReportContent, HumanDecision, EvaluationResult)
nodes.rationale: Pydantic models are the only cross-layer contract in a single-process desktop app with no HTTP API; they also validate every LLM structured output.

nodes.label: Qt Signal Contracts
nodes.rationale: Substitutes for an HTTP API: pages emit start_generation/review_decided/open_* and the worker emits progress/interrupt/finished/error signals, keeping the workflow off the UI thread.

nodes.label: SQLite Schema (assignments, workflow_runs, generated_documents, audit_logs, reference_documents)
nodes.rationale: SQLModel over SQLite with WAL, synchronous=NORMAL, foreign_keys=ON; source_records and workflow_runs exist but are never written by the workflow, and there are no FK cascade rules.

nodes.label: Repositories (Assignment, WorkflowRun, Document, AuditLog)
nodes.rationale: Each repository commits inside its methods with no unit-of-work, so persist_node's three writes are three independent transactions and a mid-way failure leaves partial history. Migrations only bump schema_versions - a placeholder, not a framework.

nodes.label: LangGraph SQLite Checkpointer
nodes.rationale: A separate storage/workflow_checkpoints.db via SqliteSaver is what makes interrupt/resume and crash recovery work; one connection per get_checkpointer() call.
